name: WazirX , $230,000,000
technique: Custody interface manipulation; Blind signing; Multisig access control bypass
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the RevertIQ label and description.
rootCause: On July 18, 2024, WazirX’s multisig wallet on Ethereum was breached after attackers manipulated the transaction signing process, causing loss of over $230 million in digital assets. The incident was attributed to a breakdown in custody interface and signing verification controls. The attackers exploited a discrepancy between the custody interface’s displayed transaction details and the actual payload being signed by multisig participants, likely enabling blind signing of a malicious payload that transferred control and assets away from the WazirX-managed wallet.
